item.title: Sánchez exculpa a Marruecos de crisis en Ceuta; informe policial apunta a fuerzas de Rabat: ¿quién tiene la verdad?
item.description: En una comparecencia ante el Congreso, el presidente del Gobierno de España, Pedro Sánchez, sostuvo este jueves 3 de septiembre que “no existen pruebas sólidas” de que las autoridades marroquíes diseñaran o ejecutaran la entrada masiva de migrantes ocurrida a finales de julio en Ceuta. item.title: Over 1,700 Indonesians get food poisoning after eating state-issued free meals
item.description: Another 777 students and teachers contracted food poisoning in Indonesia’s Central Java after consuming government-issued free meals, a school principal said on Thursday, bringing the total number of people made ‌ill by the scheme to more than 1,700 in just a week. In separate incidents in three other locations this week, 950 Indonesians had fallen ill as a result of food poisoning linked to the programme, a member of a parliamentary commission overseeing health said. item.title: France's Macron meets UK PM Burnham at Downing Street
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron met Britain’s new Prime Minister, Andy Burnham, for official talks at 10 Downing Street. The meeting came a day after the pair were joined by King Charles and Queen Camilla at the British Museum for a preview of the Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London. Macron is the first EU leader to meet Burnham. Talks are expected to cover relations between Britain and the European Union, support for Ukraine, and migrant crossings in the English Channel. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Informe desde Madrid: Sánchez niega participación de Marruecos en entrada de migrantes a Ceuta
item.description: El presidente del Gobierno español, Pedro Sánchez, se enfrentó a todos los grupos del Parlamento, incluido su propio partido, por la situación migratoria en Ceuta. Sánchez insistió que no tienen pruebas contundentes de la participación marroquí en la llegada de 70.000 personas a territorio español entre el 30 y 31 de julio y volvió a apuntar a la desinformación presuntamente originada por Rusia e Israel. Nuestra corresponsal Marina Colorado nos amplió la información sobre la declaración del jefe de Gobierno. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Israeli attacks in West Bank at 'unprecedented' level, PNI leader Barghouti says
item.description: In an interview with FRANCE 24, the secretary general of the Palestinian National Initiative (PNI) party Mustafa Barghouti said the level of Israeli attacks on Palestinians in the West Bank had become "totally unprecedented". With tensions escalating, activists accuse settlers of operating with total impunity. "Their goal is clear: it is ethnic cleansing," Barghouti stated, calling Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's reaction to the attacks hypocritical. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Marc PERELMAN

item.title: "No hay pruebas": Pedro Sánchez reiteró en el Congreso que no tiene evidencias para acusar a Marruecos del caos migratorio en Ceuta
item.description: El presidente del gobierno de España se presentó ante el Congreso para dar explicaciones sobre el trágico cruce de miles de migrantes el 30 y 31 de julio. El líder socialista enfrenta la fuerte presión de la oposición, que exige su renuncia tras la crisis migratoria. Fuente: Clarín - Mundo.

item.title: Nicaragua sin oposición: ¿se consolida la dinastía Ortega-Murillo?
item.description: Nicaragua avanza hacia una nueva reforma constitucional que amplía de seis a siete años el mandato presidencial y restringe la participación de sectores de la oposición en futuras elecciones. El Gobierno de Daniel Ortega y Rosario Murillo defiende estos cambios como parte de un modelo propio de democracia, mientras sus críticos alertan de una mayor concentración del poder y del cierre de los espacios para la alternancia política. ¿Está Nicaragua ante la consolidación de una dinastía Ortega? Lo analizamos. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: ‘Diversity is true beauty of society’: B'desh PM extends Janmashtami greetings
item.description: Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman extended Janmashtami greetings to the Hindu community. He stated that the country belongs to all citizens, who enjoy equal rights. The Prime Minister distributed honorariums to priests and sebaits. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Spain’s PM says no evidence ‘whatsoever’ Morocco behind Ceuta border breach
item.description: Pedro Sánchez continues to defend Rabat after police report claiming border forces helped 70,000 cross border Europe live – latest updates Spain has seen no evidence “whatsoever” that Morocco planned or facilitated a mass border breach into its north African territory of Ceuta, the Spanish prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has told parliament. The address on Thursday followed the emergence of a police report, commissioned by a judge and widely quoted in the media, claiming Moroccan border forces had actively aided about 70,000 people to cross the border in late July. item.title: Spain's Sanchez says no 'solid proof' that Morocco planned Ceuta crisis
item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has told lawmakers that there is no evidence the Ceuta migrant crisis was orchestrated by Morocco's government. His remarks come a day after tens of thousands of people took part in protests across the country to criticize his handling of the migrant influx. He acknowledged that Ceuta was both a humanitarian crisis and an administrative challenge. But he rejected the findings of a police report that seemed to lay blame on Morocco. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid, Spain. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Meloni government sets longevity record in Italy
item.description: Giorgia Meloni's hard-right government has been in power for 1,413 days. She surpassed the record set by Silvio Berlusconi between 2001 and 2005, making her government Italy's longest serving uninterrupted government since World War II, after a period of intense instability. Italy has had 68 governments in the last 80 years. Giorgia Meloni and her party will celebrate the feat on Friday with a huge pre-election rally in the southern city of Bari. FRANCE 24's Seema Gupta tells more. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

The move comes after President Donald Trump signed a National Security Presidential Memorandum on August 13 calling for the use of foreign shipbuilding capacity and investment. item.title: Over 50,000 protest in Madrid over Spain's handling of Cueta migrant crisis
item.description: Spain witnessed a large-scale protest as thousands rallied against the recent surge of migrants flooding into Ceuta. Demonstrators demanded the resignation of the Prime Minister and a plan for either repatriation or redistribution of the newcomers. Over seventy thousand migrants breached the Spanish border within just two days in July. The government blames human trafficking and misinformation for the perilous crossings, though Morocco refutes claims of managing this mass movement. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

El exmandatario se desplazaría en una caravana conformada por vehículos blindados de alta gama, con un nivel de protección muy similar al que resguarda al actual presidente del país. Sumado a ello, Contreras detalló que en Shinahota operarían varios anillos de seguridad. El primero estaría integrado por Comités de Autodefensa, seguido por afiliados a sindicatos cocaleros que cumplen labores de vigilancia por turnos. El tercer anillo estaría conformado por reservistas con experiencia en el manejo de armamento y como último nivel de protección, según el exvocero, existiría un resguardo compuesto por extranjeros equipados con armas de fuego. Por si esto fuera poco, Contreras relató que la carretera principal entre Cochabamba y Santa Cruz fue desviada para evitar que el tránsito vehicular pase cerca de su cuartel general. “En la población de Lauca Ñ está lo que ellos llaman el 'Estado Mayor'. Primero, la carretera principal entre Cochabamba y Santa Cruz está bloqueada desde hace dos años, han hecho un desvío por una circunvalación para que los vehículos no pasen precisamente por este lugar”, explicó durante una entrevista con ERBOL. item.title: Green party members back Zack Polanski to stand in London byelection
item.description: Party leader in England and Wales seen as favourite to contest Holborn and St Pancras after Starmer’s resignation Zack Polanski moved a step closer in his quest to become an MP on Wednesday, with local Green party members supporting him to become the party’s candidate in the Holborn and St Pancras byelection. The party leader in England and Wales started campaigning alongside his fellow Green, Hannah Spencer, the MP for Gorton and Denton, in the Holborn area on Tuesday, and is seriously considering putting himself forward as the party’s candidate in the seat vacated by Keir Starmer on Monday… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
